meta.comment: Receives HMAC-signed borrow-request events from Convex (see convex/webhooks.ts). Verifies the signature before doing anything. SAFE DEFAULT: the notification is a logged mock; the real email node is present but DISABLED and carries only a placeholder credential. After importing: (1) set this workflow as active, (2) in Settings set the Error Workflow to the imported 'LendLoop - Error Handler', (3) make sure env N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET matches the Convex deployment.

nodes.name: Send Email (disabled)
nodes.notes: Disabled on purpose. Configure a real SMTP credential and a real recipient resolution step, then enable.
